Distra 0.1.1

Distra 0.1.1 adds themes, makes icon packs actually work on current Discord, and starts up faster. Built and tested against **Discord 348.0 (113691)**.

> [!WARNING]
> Unofficial modification, not affiliated with Discord. Client mods break Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk. Plugins run with full access to your account: only enable what you understand.

## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| **Distra.ipa** | Discord 348.0 with Distra injected, for sideloading (AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly, TrollStore…). Includes the Plumpy and Iconsax icon packs with Distra's additions. |
| **Distra.dylib** | Inject into Discord yourself (LiveContainer, IPA patchers). No Substrate needed. |
| **…iphoneos-arm.deb** / **…iphoneos-arm64.deb** | Rootful / rootless jailbreak packages. |
| distra.js | The JS bundle on its own (already embedded in all of the above). |

## What's new

### Themes
- **Settings > Distra > Themes**: apply Vendetta (spec 2), Bunny (spec 3) and Enmity theme files, installed from a link, pasted, or picked from the new **Theme Library**.
- The Theme Library has 21 themes: 4 made for Distra (Distra Night, Distra Daylight, Ember, Moss) and 17 community themes, including Catppuccin, Nord, Dracula, Tokyo Night and Gruvbox, redistributed under their authors' MIT and BSD licences ([credits](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/builtin-themes/LICENSES.md)).
- Themes made for older Discord versions are mapped onto the current design, so they colour today's surfaces instead of half-applying.
- Themes only change how Discord looks on your device. Your Discord appearance setting is never changed or synced.
- Choose which base theme they fall back to (or match Discord), and hide theme backgrounds if you prefer.
- The tweak also applies theme colours to the parts of Discord drawn natively.
- Plugins that use the Vendetta/Bunny theme APIs (Monet Theme, Themes+) now work.

### Icon packs
- Packs now apply to Discord's current icons. Previously they could select but change nothing, because Discord resolves icons through its own transformer.
- **Download Plumpy and Iconsax in the app** (Settings > Distra > Icon Packs) on dylib and jailbreak installs; the IPA still bundles them.
- **Plumpy**: 13 missing icons drawn to match the pack, and a fixed settings-row chevron.
- **Iconsax**: rosiecord's pack only covered Discord's old icon names. It now has 126 icons for Discord 348, built from Iconsax's own artwork, plus drawn ones where Iconsax has no match.
- Installed packs offer an update when Distra's additions change.

### Other
- **Faster startup**: plugin startup went from about 4.5 s to under 1 s on a warm launch (metro lookup caching, one native call for built-in plugin code, cheaper JSX interception).
- Animated custom badges (Global Badges) now animate.
- The startup banner only appears when something went wrong. The "running" banner is optional in Developer settings.
- Server Drawer and Read All improvements.

## Known limits

- Only Discord 348.0 is supported.
- How much of the natively drawn UI themes cover is still being measured.
- Some plugins have open issues; the Plugin Library marks them.

Built-in plugins and themes keep their own licenses; credits in [builtin-plugins/README.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/builtin-plugins/README.md) and [builtin-themes/LICENSES.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/builtin-themes/LICENSES.md).

Distra 0.1.0

The first full release of Distra, a Discord mod for iOS. Built and tested against **Discord 348.0 (113691)**.

> [!WARNING]
> Unofficial modification, not affiliated with Discord. Client mods break Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk. Plugins run with full access to your account: only enable what you understand.

## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| **Distra.ipa** | Discord 348.0 with Distra injected, for sideloading (AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly, TrollStore…). Includes the Plumpy and Iconsax icon packs from rosiecord. |
| **Distra.dylib** | Inject into Discord yourself (LiveContainer, IPA patchers). No Substrate needed. |
| **…iphoneos-arm.deb** / **…iphoneos-arm64.deb** | Rootful / rootless jailbreak packages. |
| distra.js | The JS bundle on its own (already embedded in all of the above). |

IPAs are only published with full releases; the rolling [beta](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/releases/tag/beta) has the dylib and .debs.

## What's in it

- Runs plugins written for **Vendetta**, **Bunny/Revenge**, **Enmity** and **Aliucord**, managed from a Distra section in Discord's own settings.
- **98 built-in plugins**, all off until you turn them on in *Settings > Distra > Plugin Library*:
  - 5 of Distra's own: **Message Logger** (deleted messages and edit history, greyed-out deleted images), **Platform Indicators**, **Radial Status**, **Hide Chat Buttons** (with swipe to collapse) and **Fake Nitro**.
  - 93 community plugins, pinned to their upstream source and patched for Discord 348. Each was enabled and checked on a device alongside the others; results are in [docs/PLUGIN_TESTING.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/docs/PLUGIN_TESTING.md).
- Icon packs and extra app icons.
- Crash-loop protection with an automatic safe mode, an on-device log viewer (three-finger long press), and a remote debugger for development.

## Known limits

- Only Discord 348.0 is supported. Other versions may load but plugin fixes target 348.
- Themes are not supported yet (planned).
- Some plugins have open issues; the Plugin Library marks them, and [PLUGIN_TESTING.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/docs/PLUGIN_TESTING.md) lists what each one was checked for.

Distra is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Built-in plugins keep their own licenses; credits in [builtin-plugins/README.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/builtin-plugins/README.md).

# uYouEnhanced v21.20.4-3.0.5

> **Note:** `uYou 3.0.5` in this release is an **Unofficial Update**, a patched build of MiRO92's uYou 3.0.4 with modern-uYou download fixes applied on top by uYouEnhanced. It is not an official release by MiRO92.

## DIY (Build uYouEnhanced Yourself) 🛠️

This decision was made because uYouEnhanced and other similar tweaks have been subject to DMCA takedowns by Google. As a result, IPA files cannot be publicly released or hosted on this platform. Please read the [Wiki - Building](https://github.com/arichornlover/uYouEnhanced/wiki/Building) guide for building your own uYouEnhanced ipa.

## What's Big in 21.20.4-3.0.5 🚀

**uYou Downloads Actually Complete Now** | The download pipeline was reworked again and this time it's solid: video downloads finish (with audio muxed when available) and audio-only downloads land as real audio files instead of silent video. Also fixed the "unsupported URL" (`-1002`) failures on newer YouTube builds, fixed the uYou button crashing on the new Shorts button interface, and swapped uYou's old MobileFFmpeg framework for **FFmpegKitNext 9.0.0** for faster, more reliable muxing/converting.
Note: this still relies on SABR downloading via YouMod, and Shorts downloading remains broken for now (crash was only fixed for stability for uYouEnhanced).

**uYouEnhanced Debug Logs** | A new **uYouEnhanced Debug Logs** button in Settings exports a full, timestamped log of tweak activity one of the most useful additions yet for diagnosing and reporting problems. Log contents will vary with the YouTube version you're on and could be very useful for bug reports!

**iOS 26.5 SDK** | Switched the build SDK from `18.6` to `26.5` (originally planned for `21.14.4-3.0.5`) and fixed everything in uYouEnhanced that broke with the newer SDK. **Warning:** Do not use the iOS 27+ SDKs as they are not supported/buildable for uYouEnhanced atm, which includes tweaks like Alderis color picker.

**YouMod 2.0.0 Migration** | The YouMod migration was updated from `1.3.0` to `2.0.0` (YouMod is by [@Tonwalter888](https://github.com/Tonwalter888) — please show them support!). It is **not** backwards compatible and things are very different this time, so if you migrated on 1.3.0, but still use uYouEnhanced then please migrate again in this release.

**Lots of Polish & Fixes** | 25 issues solved in total, outdated uYouEnhanced options modernized, a reimagined **Red Progress Bar** toggle (YouSlider-based), the **Credits** screen evolved, **YTHoldForSpeed** restored, the **YouTube Sign-In Patch** is now always-on (no longer a toggle), and stale hooks for classes removed from modern YouTube were cleaned up.

## uYouEnhanced Features

-   **Notifications Tab** | Restores the pre-2020 Pivot Bar Notifications tab with customization options, now with position control.
-   **BackUp & Restore PLUS Settings** | Copy/paste your tweak settings via clipboard or file, including tweak-compatible extras beyond uYouPlus.
-   **uYouEnhanced Debug Logs** | Export a detailed activity log straight from Settings to help troubleshoot and report issues.
-   **BigYTMiniPlayer** | Brings back the classic big mini player bar with video info on iPhone (and works on the modern YouTube mini player too).
-   **Red Progress Bar** | A reimagined red progress bar, rebuilt from YouSlider-based code (conflicts with YouSlider — only one can be enabled).
-   **YouTimeStamp** | Copy the video URL with the exact timestamp for easy sharing.
-   **Low Contrast Mode** | Dims labels and icons for a less bright interface (specific app versions only).
-   **Fake YouTube Premium** | Premium-style logo and buttons for a premium appearance.
-   **No Heatwaves** | Removes the heatwave effect in the video player.
-   **No Upgrade Dialog** | Disables YouTube's update prompts.
-   **App Settings Overlay Options** | Hide sections like Account, Autoplay, and more.
-   **App Version Spoofer** | Spoof the app version number when needed.
-   **uYou 3.0.5 (Unofficial, downloads fixed)** | All original uYou download features (video/audio downloads, conversion, metadata) are now powered by uYouEnhanced's reworked download pipeline, with FFmpegKitNext 9.0.0 handling muxing and conversion.

## Release Information

Current YouTube Version: `v21.20.4`  
Current uYou Version: `v3.0.5` *(Unofficial Update of 3.0.4)*  
Current App Compatibility: `iOS/iPadOS 16.0` or later.

**RELEASE:** October 9, 2026

-   YouTube base updated to `v21.20.4`
-   Fixed: uYou downloads not completing / silent audio-only downloads (audio was being saved as video)
-   Fixed: uYou downloading on YouTube 21.29+ (`Error: unsupported URL - Code: -1002`)
-   Fixed: uYou button crashing on the new Shorts button interface
-   Fixed: 25 community-reported issues (see below)
-   Added YouTubeLegacy (Submodule)

-   Changed: build SDK `18.6` → `26.5` (do not use iOS 27+ SDKs)

-   Changed: modernized several outdated uYouEnhanced options
-   Restored: **YTHoldForSpeed**

The tweak is compiled from this fork's source, so its changes are included.

Also available through the [Meta's Apps source](https://ometavr.github.io/ipa-source/source.json).

---

<details><summary>Upstream release notes</summary>

# EeveeSpotify 7.0.0

A ground-up overhaul of the tweak's interface, built around native **iOS 26 Liquid Glass**, plus a redesigned settings app, a remote flag browser, and a large batch of stability and privacy fixes.
---

## ✨ Liquid Glass UI *(iOS 26)*

A new opt-in rendering layer that replaces Spotify's stock chrome with real system glass, toggleable surface-by-surface — take the tab bar without touching the player.

- **Tab bar** — a genuine `UITabBar` rendered as native glass, with taps replayed onto Spotify's own tab items
- **Now Playing bar** — glass capsule with album-colour tinting
- **Spotify's own bars & menus** — existing blur views swapped for real `UIGlassEffect`
- **Player, lyrics, search, home, and page headers**
- **Playlist, album, and artist** glass action rows, with header and Home section controls
- **Custom lyrics view** — optional glass rendering, with the button hidden automatically when no lyrics are fetched

## 🎛️ Tab bar customization

Reorder tabs, hide tabs you never tap, hide labels for an icon-only bar, choose a launch tab, and pin any Spotify page as a custom tab. Liked Songs, Downloads, Podcasts, and Queue ship as presets; any `spotify:` URI can be added. Custom tabs navigate in-app rather than bouncing to your other Spotify install.

## 🎨 Appearance

- **AMOLED black theme** — see [Credits](#-credits) below
- **Custom accent colours** and **custom background colours**
- **Rounded playlist cover art** for library rows and playlist track rows
- **Dynamic background colours** pulled from album art
- **Home gradient control** — style (gradient or solid), height (short, medium, tall), strength, fade curve, and per-page targeting for Home, Library, and Search
- **Player backdrop** and **glass lyrics card** toggles

## 🎧 Player

Control decluttering, double-tap seek/skip zones, haptics for buttons and scrubbing, and direct access to Word-Synced lyrics.

## 📜 Lyrics & karaoke

The biggest change here: **word-synced lyrics now work in the custom lyrics view**, not just on Spotify's own lyrics screen.

- **Word-synced support for the custom lyrics view**, with a dedicated on/off toggle gating the rest of the section
- **Customisable blur intensity** (0–6) for inactive lyric lines
- **Other lyrics sources can now use line-synced mode**, not just Spicy Lyrics
- **Credits footer** with real attribution — who wrote, provided, and uploaded the lyrics
- **Official Spicy Lyrics API** with a configurable key, in-app validation, and a link to the key template
- Lyrics uncensoring fill, RTL karaoke highlighting, text alignment and reversed-direction controls

## 🔧 New settings surfaces

- **Remote flag browser** — browse, search, and override Spotify's server-side feature flags, with change-only filtering and per-flag reset
- **Curated Spotify Features page** — hidden switches Spotify already ships (trim silence, library Pro, denser rows, lock-screen options, sleep timer, and more)
- **Redesigned settings** grouped into Listening / Looks / Advanced, with per-page previews, page-level resets, and a Troubleshooting section
- **Debug logging** with export and clear

## 🛡️ Privacy & stability

- **Blocks third-party tracking SDKs** — Firebase, Facebook, Branch, and other analytics
- **Hide Jam** — strips Jam entry points from the app without touching tracks or artists that happen to be titled "Jam"
- **Blocks App Store rating prompts** — no more review popups interrupting playback
- Resolves an access-token race crash, a karaoke long-press scope bug, settings tint leaks, and assorted stability issues

---

## 🐛 Fixes in this release

### Custom lyrics view didn't update between songs

The biggest fix. Previously, opening the custom lyrics view pinned it to whatever song was playing at that moment — skip to the next track and it kept showing the old lyrics until you closed and reopened it.

It now follows the player: when the track changes, it swaps in the new song's lyrics and resets scroll position and per-line state so each song starts fresh. If the new track's lyrics aren't in hand yet, it fetches them and retries a few times before giving up.

It also tracks the **actually playing** track rather than the one a lyrics request last named — Spotify preloads lyrics for upcoming songs, so the old behaviour could latch onto the wrong one. If no lyrics turn up at all, the view closes itself instead of sitting there empty.

### iPad Liquid Glass layout

- **Tab bar rendered too small** — the glass bar inherited Spotify's short iPad strip height, squashing every item. Now floored at 50pt and centred on the original strip.
- **Album art escaped the mini player** — clipping was applied inside a radius check that iPad's capsule radius skipped entirely, so artwork bled past the corners. Clipping is now unconditional, and the artwork search is iPad-aware.

### Localisations

- Non-English tables brought in line with English
- Version appearance simplified, build number surfaced in-app
- "Rounded artwork" renamed to **"Rounded playlist cover art"** across all 27 languages

---

## 📦 Packaging

Locally built IPAs now ship with the alternate app icons baked in, and the deb dependency was corrected.

---

## 📋 At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| Minimum iOS | **16.1** |
| Liquid Glass | iOS 26 + restart |
| Languages | **27** |
| Alternate app icons | **34** |
| Spotify | 9.1.x |

---

## 📥 Install

Sign the IPA with **SideStore**, **FlareStore**, or a certificate-based signer like **RyukSign**. For jailbroken devices, grab the `.deb` matching your architecture from the releases page.

---

## 🙏 Credits

This release stands on a lot of contributed work. Thank you to everyone who opened a PR, reported an issue, or tested a build.

### Hide Jam & block rating prompts

**Hide Jam** and **Block rating prompts** were proposed and implemented by **[Incognito-Coder](https://github.com/Incognito-Coder)** in **[PR #152](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/152)** (*feat: hide Jam from menus and block app star rating dialogs*).

**Hide Jam** strips Jam out of the app without touching tracks or artists that happen to be titled "Jam" — it overrides 17 Jam-related remote configuration flags covering the queue button, guest controls, device-picker integration, nearby-session nudges, invite deep links, and local-network discovery. Rating prompts are suppressed by hooking `SKStoreReviewController` directly.

Both are off by default and take effect after restarting Spotify.

### AMOLED black theme

The optional **AMOLED black theme** was originally proposed and implemented by **[nodzen](https://github.com/nodzen)** in **[PR #126](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/126)** (*feat: add optional AMOLED black theme*).

Rather than flattening every dark surface to pure black, nodzen's approach was surgical: it replaces only opaque, nearly neutral dark `UIView` backgrounds with true black, while deliberately preserving coloured artwork-derived backgrounds, gradients, translucent materials, text, icons, and shadows. That constraint is what keeps the theme from destroying album art and glass surfaces elsewhere in the app.

The theme ships disabled by default and takes effect after restarting Spotify.

### Word-synced lyrics

**Word-synced lyrics in the custom lyrics view**

### Other contributions

- **[hooray804](https://github.com/hooray804)** — Korean localisation ([PR #172](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/172))
- **[marcinmajsc](https://github.com/marcinmajsc)** — Polish localisation and lyrics source footer ([PR #123](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/123), [PR #147](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/147))
- **[Huseyin-Korkmaz](https://github.com/Huseyin-Korkmaz)** — Turkish localisation ([PR #137](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/137))
- **[U-rTrDD-fyi](https://github.com/U-rTrDD-fyi)** — Musixmatch lyrics fix for the `apic` ELB 403 ([PR #166](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/166))
- **[karlfrank916](https://github.com/karlfrank916)** — the Messages `si` parameter report that prompted this release's share-link investigation ([#171](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/issues/171))

---

## Known issues

- **Share links to Messages still include Spotify's `si` tracking parameter** ([#171](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/issues/171)). Clean Share Links strips it for the share sheet, clipboard, and direct share targets, but the Messages route isn't covered yet. An attempted fix was reverted because it targeted a class we couldn't confirm on that code path.

---

* Take playback to a bigger screen with AirPlay or a compatible player discovered on your local network.

<details><summary>Upstream release notes</summary>

### Features

- Add an **in-app update prompt**: from the next release on, Apollo Reborn checks for updates once a day and, when one is out, lets you send it to AltStore, SideStore, Feather, or FlareStore or download the IPA, with the release notes a tap away (#1343: @IllIIllIllIllII)

  - What's New now shows the app icon you picked instead of the default one
- Open the **subreddit switcher** as a native sheet when you tap a feed's title, with search, your favorites, and live results, instead of the small floating dropdown; typing a multireddit like apple+iphone still works (#1313, #1387: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Press and hold the **Posts** tab to open it while a feed is open, now on Liquid Glass too, and the search field stays in place as you scroll the sheet
- Add a **Liquid Glass** switch (Interface → Appearance, on by default) so Liquid Glass builds can use Apollo's classic look without installing a different IPA; quit and reopen Apollo for the change to apply (#1384: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Shown on Liquid Glass builds on iOS 26 and later, except inside LiveContainer; while it's off, Liquid Glass-only options are hidden
- Add a **Minimize** Hide Style for **Hide Bars on Scroll** (Interface → Tab Bar, Liquid Glass) that shrinks the tab bar into a small glass pill showing the current tab as you scroll, like Safari; tap the pill or scroll back up to bring the full bar back (#1349, #1384: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - With any Hide Style on Liquid Glass, a tab bar or header hidden by scrolling now slides back in when you open a page or go back or forward, and the tab bar no longer comes back on its own after 30 seconds
- Add **Reduce Rate Limiting** (Accounts & API Keys → Experimental, off by default) so **API-Key-Free** accounts hit Reddit's request limit less often: profile pictures load in batches without their collectible frames, Community Highlights refresh every 30 minutes instead of every 2, and your sign-in is checked less often (#1369: @icpryde)
  - Apollo offers it once: when you sign in without an API key, or, if you're already signed in, the first time you hit the limit
  - Even with it off, API-Key-Free accounts skip repeated account requests at launch and when you come back to the app, Community Highlights wait out a rate limit, and your own profile no longer shows "has been banned" during one
- Add **Kagi** to the Search tab's **Search With** menu for Kagi subscribers: paste your Kagi Session Link once, then search Reddit through Kagi with the same result cards, Read More, and filters as Google, plus each post's score, comments, and age right away (#1305: @nickclyde)
  - Each page of results counts as one search on your Kagi plan; change or remove the link under Accounts & API Keys → Kagi Search
- Add **Open via Nitter** (Open in App → X / Twitter, off by default) to open X and Twitter links on a Nitter instance you pick from a live list or enter yourself, so you can read posts and profiles without an X account (#1334: @nickclyde)
  - Shared and copied links stay on x.com
- Open **Edit Profile** (your profile's ••• menu) inside Apollo on iOS 16 and later, signed in as the current account and styled with your theme, instead of in Safari, which often wasn't signed in (#1367: @icpryde)
  - API-key accounts without a **Reddit Web Sign-In** are asked to sign in once first
- Add **True Black Keyboard** (Interface → Display & Navigation, off by default) to make the keyboard's background pure black for OLED screens, in dark mode, light mode, or always (#1316: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add **Settings Icon Theme** (Settings → Appearance → Other, Light by default) to show settings icons as colored symbols on dark tiles, like iOS Settings in dark mode, either always (Dark) or only in dark mode (System) (#1377: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Pixel Pals now gets a rounded-square icon with your current pet, and the main Settings list drops its duplicate Apollo Ultra row (it's still under About)
- Add a **User Profiles** settings page that brings Profile Layout, **Show User Profile Pictures**, and **Profile Picture Shape** together, with a live sample comment showing how profile pictures look (#1352: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Show User Profile Pictures and Profile Picture Shape move here from Interface → Display & Navigation
- Reorganize **Subreddits** settings into Subreddit List, Subreddit Appearance, and Search Tab Sources, and redesign **Subreddit List Sections** (formerly Subreddit Sections) with a preview that looks like your real subreddit list (#1350, #1351: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - **Show Subreddit Icons** moves here from Apollo's Appearance settings, and Section Order rows now drag by their handle
  - Also fixes subreddit list rows keeping the previous light or dark mode's colors with **Subreddit List Enhancements** off
- Rework **Customize Action Menus** (Interface → Menus, formerly Action Menus) with clearer descriptions, a summary only on menus you've changed, **All Menus** showing where each action is hidden, and a **Reset Menu…** that can reset just the order (#1282, #1323, #1368: @AcornElf, @icpryde)
  - Touch-and-hold menus on posts and comments now follow your layout too, so hidden actions stay hidden and the order matches the ••• menu
  - Brings back **Remind Me In…** in the ••• menus on posts and comments on Liquid Glass, and lets you hide or move it
- Add a **Comment Link** option to **Share as Image**: Include Link becomes a **Link** menu with No Link, Post Link, or Comment Link when you share a comment, and comment GIFs shared as video carry the chosen link too (#1278: @Thetromboneman1)
  - If Include Link was on, it carries over as Post Link
- Add tile size buttons to **Gallery View** (the − and + magnifying glasses at the top) to switch between four tile sizes, from a denser grid to a single column; your choice is remembered (#1357: @jordanearle)
- Write **Apollo AI** summaries in your language even when the post, article, or comments are in another one, with a new **Language** setting (Apollo AI → Summaries, Device Default by default) (#1362: @icpryde)
  - Summaries saved before this update are written again the next time you open their thread
- Add **Custom Headers** to Apollo AI's Custom provider, for services that need extra request headers, such as the `x-opencode-session` header OpenCode Go now asks for (#1286: @icpryde)
- Start a **crosspost**'s title as the original post's title, like reddit.com does, with an (x) to clear it; long titles now wrap onto up to five lines instead of being cut off (#1290: @icpryde)
- Show the newest commenter's **profile picture** next to their name in the follow-thread **Live Activity** when **Show User Profile Pictures** is on (#1296: @icpryde)
  - Needs a self-hosted Notification Backend with avatar support
- Add **Witching Hour** and **Count Helios**, two Halloween icons, to the Helios icon pack (#1378: @IllIIllIllIllII)

### Performance

- Use less memory for very large images in **Gallery View**, Image Chest albums, and Chat, which now load at the size they're shown instead of at full resolution (#1320: @ryannair05)

### Fixes

- Fix crashes when adding or removing a **favorite** on the Subreddits list, while writing a **Media** post (for example after changing its flair), and when swiping between pages of the fullscreen **media viewer** (#1336: @icpryde)
- Fix Apollo crashing when you switch accounts with the **Inbox** open, and a rare crash when the Inbox is closed right after it opens (#1284, #1379: @icpryde)
- Fix very long **text posts** showing a blank body at the largest text sizes, or after Apollo had been open a while (#1381: @icpryde)
- Fix **Continue with Google** doing nothing and **Continue with Apple** showing an error on Reddit's sign-in page; both now open Google's or Apple's sign-in in a sheet, with or without an API key (#1372: @icpryde)
- Fix moderator tools for **API-Key-Free** moderators that came up empty, kept spinning, or silently failed (#1298, #1304, #1311: @icpryde)
  - **Removal Reasons**, **Ban Users**, **Mute Users**, **Approved Submitters**, and Apollo's own **Moderator Mail** (with Use Modern Moderator Mail off) now load, and removing a post offers **Add Removal Reason**
  - Bans, moderator invites, and accepting or declining an invite now reach Reddit
- Fix **Set Post Flair** on **API-Key-Free** accounts saying "Flair set!" while the post kept its old flair, and **AutoModerator** saves never reaching Reddit (#1309: @icpryde)
- Fix the subreddit **Sidebar** staying mostly empty and **Set User Flair** showing a blank or outdated current flair on **API-Key-Free** accounts (#1312, #1327: @IllIIllIllIllII, @nickclyde)
  - Image posts in feeds and your current flair no longer rely on Old Reddit, which Reddit is starting to restrict
- Stop the pause of a second or more between **Liquid Glass menus** when reporting a post or comment, setting post flair, or removing a post as a moderator; the next menu now opens right away (#1382: @icpryde)
  - Moderator actions such as Remove, Approve, and Spam also go through right away, and Ban User opens without the wait
- Fix swiping from the left edge still going back with **Disable Navigation Gestures** on (Settings → Gestures), and on Liquid Glass stop a right swipe over a comment leaving the thread instead of running the comment's swipe action (#1370: @icpryde)
- Stop **YouTube** videos on iOS 27 playing with captions you can't turn off; captions now show only when Closed Captions + SDH is on in iOS Settings or you turn on Subtitles in the player (#1371: @icpryde)
- Stop the search bar under the header flashing as a feed or post opens with **Header Style** set to Hard, the iOS 27 default on Liquid Glass (#1373: @icpryde)
- Show a message instead of an endless spinner when a profile's **Comments** or **Posts** come back empty, as they do when someone hides their history, or when a feed or list fails to load (#1341: @icpryde)
- Hide profile stats entirely when **Stat Cards** is off (User Profiles → Profile Layout) instead of falling back to Apollo's karma and account-age row (#1348: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix posts after the first from each subreddit showing an empty circle instead of their **subreddit icon** in Home, Popular, All, and multireddits (#1363: @icpryde)
- Fix tapping the **Posts** tab sometimes stopping short of the top of a long feed; it now goes all the way up like a status-bar tap, and the **Return Button** can take you back (#1360: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Make the **subreddit header** and **Community Highlights** follow when you switch subreddits from the feed's title, instead of keeping the previous subreddit's (#1287: @icpryde)
- Load **more replies** smoothly: the spinner stays until the replies fade in, and in a translated thread they arrive already translated instead of switching language and shifting the comments below (#1358: @icpryde)
- Fix **Bulk Translation** skipping comments that start with a quote, a list, or a link, and show translated quotes, lists, bold, and italics the way Apollo shows the original (#1294: @icpryde)
- Fix **translation** labels naming the wrong language or showing on text that wasn't translated: "Translated from…", the feed's 🌐 badge and the Translate button now name the language the translation service actually translated from, and skip comments and posts it returned unchanged (#1380: @icpryde)
  - Short comments that were translated without a label before now show one
- Stop a comment's **rich link card** image flashing each time you vote (#1356: @icpryde)
- Say why a **RedGIFs** post couldn't load instead of "RedGIFs error :(", such as removed, not found, not available in your region, or RedGIFs can't be reached (#1359: @icpryde)
- Keep a fullscreen **GIF or video** playing behind the comments sheet you open with **Swipe Up for Comments**, instead of it stopping or the screen going black (#1277: @Thetromboneman1)
- Fade the background when you drag a fullscreen image or video away sideways or at an angle, not only straight up or down (#1320: @ryannair05)
- Fix touching and holding a **modmail** or private message doing nothing on Liquid Glass, and long messages ending in a band of empty space (#1307, #1308: @icpryde)
- Keep **Google** search's cookies across launches on iOS 16 and earlier, so Google stops asking you to sign in or pass its check every time (#1315: @icpryde)
- Fix the **GIF picker**'s search bar looking double-layered on Liquid Glass (#1283: @icpryde)
- Color the navigation and tab bars with your **custom theme**'s Bars & Chrome color on non-Liquid-Glass builds, so the swipe-down search bar in subreddits and posts sits inside the top bar instead of looking like a separate strip (#1280: @Thetromboneman1)
- Fix **Apollo Reborn settings** footers and subtitles growing to body size under Rounded, Serif, and Monospaced theme fonts, and headers and footers keeping the old theme after you change it in **Theme Manager** (#1293, #1297, #1322: @icpryde)
- Stop the **Apollo AI** settings list jumping while you scroll it, after a cancelled swipe-back, and when you come back to it (#1288, #1291: @icpryde)
- Keep the section titles in **Settings Shortcuts** still when you add or remove a shortcut, and on non-Liquid-Glass builds open its menu over the screen you're on when you hold the Settings tab, instead of switching to Settings first (#1355, #1384: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Stop the **iPad** tab bar covering page titles and the Search tab's search field on Liquid Glass; titles and search fields now get their own row below the tabs (#1314: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - **Move Tab Bar to Bottom** is now **Tab Bar Position** (Interface → Tab Bar, Top by default), and the tabs keep their text labels in either position
- Reduce post and comment text and icons blanking out on **Mac** when you switch to or away from Apollo (#1301: @Thetromboneman1)


</details>

- Show a message instead of an endless spinner when a profile's **Comments** or **Posts** come back empty, as they do when someone hides their history, or when a feed or list fails to load (#1341: @icpryde)

- Fix posts after the first from each subreddit showing an empty circle instead of their **subreddit icon** in Home, Popular, All, and multireddits (#1363: @icpryde)
- Fix tapping the **Posts** tab sometimes stopping short of the top of a long feed; it now goes all the way up like a status-bar tap, and the **Return Button** can take you back (#1360: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Make the **subreddit header** and **Community Highlights** follow when you switch subreddits from the feed's title, instead of keeping the previous subreddit's (#1287: @icpryde)
- Load **more replies** smoothly: the spinner stays until the replies fade in, and in a translated thread they arrive already translated instead of switching language and shifting the comments below (#1358: @icpryde)
- Fix **Bulk Translation** skipping comments that start with a quote, a list, or a link, and show translated quotes, lists, bold, and italics the way Apollo shows the original (#1294: @icpryde)
- Fix **translation** labels naming the wrong language or showing on text that wasn't translated: "Translated from…", the feed's 🌐 badge and the Translate button now name the language the translation service actually translated from, and skip comments and posts it returned unchanged (#1380: @icpryde)

- Stop a comment's **rich link card** image flashing each time you vote (#1356: @icpryde)
- Say why a **RedGIFs** post couldn't load instead of "RedGIFs error :(", such as removed, not found, not available in your region, or RedGIFs can't be reached (#1359: @icpryde)
- Keep a fullscreen **GIF or video** playing behind the comments sheet you open with **Swipe Up for Comments**, instead of it stopping or the screen going black (#1277: @Thetromboneman1)

# Version 7.1.1

Starting from v7, NeoFreeBird will use web logins to access the platform. It’s recommended you do a fresh install of this version to avoid conflicts with web and native accounts.

1. Open the app.
2. Complete the login flow in the web view that shows up (passkeys don’t work here, so make sure you have another form of 2FA if applicable).
3. The app may crash, that’s normal (it helps ensure the credentials are saved).
4. Reopen the app, and you should be at your “For you” page!

* Doomscrolling can now be turned off with disabling video scroll.
* Added ability to use Tenor GIFs instead of GIPHY.
* Added option to export and import settings (no more coming soon!).
* Added option to always download the highest-quality MP4 file from media downloads.
* Added option to stop X from losing focus when staying out of the app for a long time.
* Added option to hide Message button on tweets.
* Added a “Download all Videos” button (only works when all media items are videos).

tweaks.localizedDescription:
Ads Speed stubs out ads from the common ad SDKs (AdMob, AppLovin, ironSource, Meta, Vungle and more) and speeds up reward-ad videos so you still get the reward. Your normal in-app video is left alone.

Jailbroken (iOS 15+): install the rootless or rootful .deb, then choose which apps it runs in under Settings > Ads Speed. Nothing happens until you enable an app there.

Not jailbroken: inject the dylib into an app's IPA. This build is always on and only speeds up web video ads, and it needs a substrate bundled in, so inject it with TrollStore + TrollFools, or Sideloadly with "Cydia Substrate" turned on.

Fork of SoulRune's Un-JailedSpeedAds.
